title: Bound the deferred six-recipient repair for owned 1551
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact [#7481](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7481) at `89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b`, two fixed chart-127 repair interfaces cannot recover the historical role-862 operand after deferring the six owned1551 updates.

- Before ADD46149, x230=−1 and x547=1 kill four named carriers and edited recipient873 while the old source is −1.
- Before ADD47956, the first outward deadline across all six recipients, a new exact 20-coordinate input kills all 644 edited chart-127 rows while the old source is −2. Independent literal replay checks both prefixes, all 73 INIT/COPY guards in each trace, and the signed changes to all six recipients. The earlier probe leaves 284 nonzero responses at this later cut.

Deleting the rank-four MOVE has optimistic gross about 67.657064563108 raw before repair. No literal edit survives either fixed interface. κ stays unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Refine the fixed-paid repair scope for the complex supplier on canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, with signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7491](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7491) treats one outward ADD on the original chart, while this scope changes the first repair to chart127 for six recipients. The two separate CI prerequisites reuse [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257).

## Validation

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-owned1551-fanout-banks/replay.py
```

The wrapper authenticates the exact source inputs, regenerates both separators and the directed price, and checks altered-input and wrong-response controls. It preserves the original capped receipt as provenance. Direct and registered replay, commit modes and source-history checks, read-only Git-free export and 27 onboarding tests passed locally. Neither cut reached a literal construction or physical replay.

## Credit

[#7491](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7491) supplies the single-recipient receiver-bank method. [#7003](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7003) supplies old-source timing, #7481/#7480/#7334 the exact native lineage, #7113 the signed caller, #7482/#7298 the coefficient and directed-price tools, and #7499 public copies of the pinned inputs. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging. Review and merge remain with maintainers.

## Open next questions

Other repair times, earlier encodings and changed paid routes remain open. A different route must carry the historical operand before the first outward read and restore all six independent returns at positive full price.
